messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: p1 oncall (eu) — elevated 5xx rate from routing layer -> downstream model errors. Affected region: eu-west. Customers: several PLG users reporting degraded completions. Dashboard: https://console.internal/reports/eu-routing?incident=2244123456

maria: I'm on it. I'm seeing a spike starting ~2244123300 on the EU edge routers. Can someone grab a tail of the routing logs + fallback decisions?

devon: pulling logs now. quick snapshot: lots of `fallback_choice=rm-3b-q4` followed by `downstream_timeout` then `fallback_selected=rm-3b-q4` again. suspicious repeated fallback selection.

sre-kyle: oncall handover (joining). If fallbacks are selecting the same heavy variant repeatedly, could be a policy loop where model_variant mapping didn't include a lighter fallback. sending runbook checklist.

maria: run these commands and paste outputs:```bash
# routing table live
curl -sS http://eu-router-01.internal/debug/routes | jq '.policies[] | select(.name|test("fallback_policy"))'
# policy hash
cat /etc/redwood/policies/fallback_policy_v2.json | sha256sum
```

devon: pasted results — route policy shows `fallback_chain: [rm-3b-q4, rm-13b-q8]` (both bigger models). hash differs between eu-router-01 and eu-router-02. eu-01-> a8f3..., eu-02-> b1c9...

anjali: that explains the misroute/spillover. If eu-01 had policy A and eu-02 had policy B pointing to heavier variants, requests could get routed across and overload certain backends, causing cascading timeouts -> spillover to other regions.

ops-bot: :information_source: deploy-bot detected config push to routing-service at 2244123270 by infra-ci (pipeline #8721). Rollout target: eu/routers, canary: eu-01, rollout_status: FAILED->partial (eu-02 not converged).

maria: can we force reload the correct policy on eu-02 and set the router to prefer local model pools? I want to avoid sending more requests to US.

sre-kyle: doing a controlled revert now on eu-02:```bash
ssh eu-02
sudo systemctl restart redwood-router
sudo redwoodctl policy load /etc/redwood/policies/fallback_policy_v2.json --verify
```

(1 minute later)
sre-kyle: restarted and forced reload. policy hashes now match: eu-01/eu-02 -> a8f3... responses are normalizing on the dashboards. 5xx rate dropping.

pm-ling: customer outreach: started drafting status for affected customers. asking for ETA on full recovery and mitigation steps.

devon: posting short log snippet showing the misroute traces for timeline assembly:```text
2244123265 eu-01 request_id=abc123 client=acme-corp model_request -> selected_node=eu-02 fallback_choice=rm-3b-q4 downstream_timeout
2244123272 eu-02 request_id=abc124 client=acme-corp model_request -> selected_node=us-01 fallback_choice=rm-13b-q8 overloaded
2244123280 eu-01 request_id=abc125 client=beta-saas model_request -> selected_node=eu-01 fallback_choice=rm-3b-q4 ok
```

anjali: taking notes for in-incident RCA thread: preliminary hypothesis: config drift during rollout caused inconsistent fallback chains across EU routers, leading to cross-region spillover and heavier fallback selection than intended. That amplified load on a subset of model pools, producing timeouts and cascading failovers.

maria: customer impact estimate: 18 minutes of elevated errors from 2244123260-2244124340, affecting ~3% of completion requests for EU customers. Some degraded latency for others due to increased cross-region hops.

sre-kyle: mitigation checklist: revert/pin policy version across routers; add pre-flight checksum gate to rollout pipeline; throttle cross-region routing during degraded states; add alert on policy hash mismatch. Executing postmortem tasks now.

pm-ling: noted. I'll send a customer-facing summary once SLO impact numbers are confirmed.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: incident-bot cleared page at 2244123900 based on error-rate thresholds returning to baseline.

anjali: follow-ups (tracking): [1] Add policy checksum monitor (owner: eng-platform), [2] Add canary convergence check to CI (owner: eng-infra), [3] Add fallback-chain unit tests in model-roster (owner: eng-ml), [4] Post-incident RCA doc and timeline (owner: maria).

maria: I'll assemble the timeline & upload logs to the incident bucket. tagging for RCA grooming: @eng-platform @eng-infra @eng-ml. thanks all for quick triage. :thumbsup:
